paragraphs.s: GRAMMAR: RELATIVE PRONOUNS
paragraphs.tr: 语法：关系代词。

ana.frame: 小标题：GRAMMAR: RELATIVE PRONOUNS（语法：关系代词）
ana.tip: which 指物、who 指人、where 指地点、when 指时间、whose 表所有。

paragraphs.s: B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with relative pronouns.
paragraphs.tr: B1 Preliminary 的考生经常在关系代词上出错。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with relative pronouns.
parts: with relative pronouns —— 在关系代词上
gram: make mistakes with 在……上出错
ana.tip: 口诀：人 who、物 which、地点 where、时间 when、所有 whose。

paragraphs.s: ① Correct the mistakes in these sentences using the relative pronouns in the box.
paragraphs.tr: ① 用方框里的关系代词改正这些句子里的错误。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Correct the mistakes in these sentences using the relative pronouns in the box.
parts: using the relative pronouns in the box —— 用方框里的关系代词
gram: correct the mistake 改正错误
ana.tip: For each gap, first decide what kind of word you need, e.g. a pronoun.

paragraphs.s: A which
paragraphs.tr: A which。

ana.frame: 关系代词：which
ana.tip: 先行词是「物/事」时用。

paragraphs.s: B who
paragraphs.tr: B who。

ana.frame: 关系代词：who
ana.tip: 先行词是「人」时用（作主语）。

paragraphs.s: C where
paragraphs.tr: C where。

ana.frame: 关系副词：where
ana.tip: 先行词是「地点」时用。

paragraphs.s: D when
paragraphs.tr: D when。

ana.frame: 关系副词：when
ana.tip: 先行词是「时间」时用。

paragraphs.s: E whose
paragraphs.tr: E whose。

ana.frame: 关系代词：whose
parts: whose —— 指代人或者物的（所有格）
ana.tip: 后面接名词（whose house 他的房子）。

note.cn: （关系代词）指代人或者物的（所有格）

paragraphs.s: The fish who I saw was a shark, I think.
paragraphs.tr: 我看到的那条鱼是条鲨鱼，我想。

ana.frame: 主系表：The fish who I saw was a shark, I think.
parts: The fish who I saw —— 我看到的那条鱼（who 这里错了）
clauses: 定语从句（关系代词作宾语）
ana.tip: 有错：fish 是「物」→ which（that 也可以）。官方：1 who → which/that。

paragraphs.s: Buenos Aires, which my cousins live, is a long way from here.
paragraphs.tr: 我表亲住的布宜诺斯艾利斯离这里很远。

ana.frame: 主系表：Buenos Aires, which my cousins live, is a long way from here.
parts: Buenos Aires, which my cousins live —— 我表亲住的布宜诺斯艾利斯（which 这里错了）
is a long way from here —— 离这里很远
ana.tip: 有错：先行词是地点（城市）→ where。官方：2 which → where。

paragraphs.s: My big sister Layla, that is 17, is going to university next year.
paragraphs.tr: 我姐姐 Layla，17 岁，明年要上大学了。

ana.frame: 主系表：My big sister Layla, that is 17, is going to university next year.
parts: My big sister Layla, that is 17 —— 我姐姐 Layla，17 岁（that 这里错了）
is going to university next year —— 明年要上大学
clauses: 非限制性定语从句（不能用 that）
ana.tip: 有错：非限制性从句不能用 that，指人用 who。官方：3 that → who。

paragraphs.s: The neighbours, which house is much bigger than ours, have two cars.
paragraphs.tr: 邻居家（房子比我们大得多）有两辆车。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：The neighbours, which house is much bigger than ours, have two cars.
parts: The neighbours, which house is much bigger than ours —— 邻居（which 这里错了）
ana.tip: 有错：「邻居的房子」表所有 → whose。官方：4 which → whose。

paragraphs.s: That's the boy which I told you about.
paragraphs.tr: 那就是我跟你说过的那个男孩。

ana.frame: 主系表：That's the boy which I told you about.
parts: the boy which I told you about —— 我跟你说过的那个男孩（which 这里错了）
clauses: 定语从句（关系代词作宾语）
ana.tip: 有错：boy 是「人」→ who（that 也可以）。官方：5 which → who/that。

paragraphs.s: It was in February, where the weather was cold, that I bought this coat.
paragraphs.tr: 我是在二月（天气很冷的时候）买这件外套的。

ana.frame: 强调句：It was in February, where the weather was cold, that I bought this coat.
parts: in February, where the weather was cold —— 在二月（where 这里错了）
bought this coat —— 买了这件外套
ana.tip: 有错：先行词是时间（February）→ when。官方：6 where → when。

paragraphs.s: A good cook is someone who food always tastes good!
paragraphs.tr: 好厨师就是做出来的饭菜总是好吃的人！

ana.frame: 主系表：A good cook is someone who food always tastes good!
parts: someone who food always tastes good —— 饭菜总是好吃的人（who 这里错了）
gram: whose + 名词（whose food 他的饭菜）
ana.tip: 有错：「某人的饭菜」表所有 → whose。官方：7 who → whose。

paragraphs.s: There's the house that I used to live.
paragraphs.tr: 那就是我以前住的房子。

ana.frame: 主系表：There's the house that I used to live.
parts: the house that I used to live —— 我以前住的房子（that 这里错了）
gram: where 指地点；live 是不及物动词
ana.tip: 有错：live 后面缺地点 → where（或 that … live in）。官方：8 that → where。

note.cn: 过去常常（used to do sth）

paragraphs.s: FOCUS: IDENTIFYING PART OF SPEECH
paragraphs.tr: 重点：判断词性。

ana.frame: 小标题：FOCUS: IDENTIFYING PART OF SPEECH
ana.tip: 先想「这个空缺什么词性」，再想填哪个词。

paragraphs.s: ② Complete each sentence with one word.
paragraphs.tr: ② 每个句子填一个词补全。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Complete each sentence with one word.
ana.tip: 首先判断每个空格需要填入哪类词，例如，介词。

paragraphs.s: The girl {146} lives in that house goes to my school.
paragraphs.tr: 住在那栋房子里的女孩上我的学校。

ana.frame: 主谓：The girl ____ lives in that house goes to my school.
parts: The girl {146} lives in that house —— 住在那个房子里的女孩
goes to my school —— 上我的学校
ana.tip: 空后是谓语动词、先行词是「人」→ 填 who。官方：1 who。

paragraphs.s: In some countries you can't drive a car {147} you're 18.
paragraphs.tr: 在一些国家，你 18 岁前不能开车。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：you can't drive a car ____ you're 18.
parts: can't drive a car —— 不能开车
ana.tip: 「直到 18 岁」→ 填 until。官方：2 until（也有人用 unless，意思不同：除非）。

paragraphs.s: We'll go to the shopping mall tomorrow if we {148} enough time.
paragraphs.tr: 如果时间够，我们明天去购物中心。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：We'll go to the shopping mall tomorrow if we ____ enough time.
parts: 'll go to the shopping mall —— 要去购物中心
if we {148} enough time —— 如果我们……足够时间
ana.tip: 「有时间」→ 填 have。官方：3 have。

paragraphs.s: Take some money with you in {149} you want to buy a drink.
paragraphs.tr: 带点钱，以防你想买饮料。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Take some money with you in ____ you want to buy a drink.
parts: Take some money with you —— 带点钱
in {149} you want to buy a drink —— 以防你想买饮料
ana.tip: 「以防」→ 填 case（in case）。官方：4 case。

note.cn: 以防万一（in case + 从句）

paragraphs.s: I always like to take part {150} as many different sports as I can.
paragraphs.tr: 我总是喜欢尽可能参加多种运动。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：I always like to take part ____ as many different sports as I can.
parts: like to take part {150} —— 喜欢参加……
as many different sports as I can —— 尽可能多的运动
ana.tip: 「参加」→ 填 in（take part in）。官方：5 in。

paragraphs.s: Let's leave now {151} we don't have to run to catch the bus.
paragraphs.tr: 我们现在走吧，这样就不用跑着赶公交。

ana.frame: 主谓：Let's leave now ____ we don't have to run to catch the bus.
parts: Let's leave now —— 我们现在走吧
{151} we don't have to run to catch the bus —— 这样就不用跑着赶公交
ana.tip: 「以便、这样」→ 填 so。官方：6 so。空填完后检查全文通顺（After you fill in all the gaps, make sure the completed text makes sense.）。

paragraphs.s: ③ Which of your answers above are:
paragraphs.tr: ③ 你上面的答案里，哪些是：

ana.frame: 疑问句：Which of your answers above are:
parts: Which of your answers above —— 你上面答案里的哪些
ana.tip: 把六个答案按词性分类（下面四类）。

paragraphs.s: verb forms? (e.g. was)
paragraphs.tr: 动词形式？（例如 was）

ana.frame: 类别：verb forms?（动词形式）
ana.tip: 如 was、have。

paragraphs.s: linking words or part of linking expressions? (e.g. though, in order to)
paragraphs.tr: 连接词或连接表达的一部分？（例如 though、in order to）

ana.frame: 类别：linking words or part of linking expressions?（连接词/连接表达）
parts: linking words or part of linking expressions —— 连接词或连接表达的一部分
ana.tip: 如 though、so that、in case。

paragraphs.s: prepositions? (e.g. of)
paragraphs.tr: 介词？（例如 of）

ana.frame: 类别：prepositions?（介词）
ana.tip: 如 of、in、to。

paragraphs.s: relative pronouns? (e.g. which)
paragraphs.tr: 关系代词？（例如 which）

ana.frame: 类别：relative pronouns?（关系代词）
ana.tip: 如 which、who。

paragraphs.s: ④ In pairs, look at the gaps in this paragraph and for each one decide what kind of word is needed. Then complete each gap with one suitable word.
paragraphs.tr: ④ 两人一组，看这段文字里的空，逐个判断需要什么词性，然后用一个合适的词填空。

ana.frame: 祈使句：look at the gaps in this paragraph and for each one decide what kind of word is needed. Then complete each gap with one suitable word.
parts: look at the gaps in this paragraph —— 看这段里的空
decide what kind of word is needed —— 判断需要什么词性
Then complete each gap with one suitable word —— 用一个合适的词填空
ana.tip: 先定词性（代词？介词？连接词？），再定词。

paragraphs.s: Snow biking is a new winter sport (1) {158} is now becoming very popular.
paragraphs.tr: 雪地骑行是一项新的冬季运动，现在正变得越来越流行。

ana.frame: 主系表：Snow biking is a new winter sport (1) ____ is now becoming very popular.
parts: a new winter sport (1) {158} —— 一项新的冬季运动（缺关系代词）
is now becoming very popular —— 正变得越来越流行
ana.tip: 指物、作从句主语 → 填 which。官方：1 which。

paragraphs.s: It's similar (2) {159} mountain biking in that it involves riding down steep hills, often at high speed, but on snow or ice (3) {160} of on ordinary ground.
paragraphs.tr: 它和山地骑行很像，都是冲下陡坡、常常高速，只不过是在雪地或冰面上而不是普通地面。

ana.frame: 主系表：It's similar (2) ____ mountain biking … but on snow or ice (3) ____ of on ordinary ground.
parts: in that it involves riding down steep hills, often at high speed —— 在于都是冲下陡坡
but on snow or ice (3) {160} of on ordinary ground —— 但在雪地/冰面而非普通地面（缺 instead）
gram: be similar to 与……相似；instead of 而不是
ana.tip: similar to → 填 to；「而不是」→ 填 instead（instead of）。官方：2 to / 3 instead。

paragraphs.s: Snow biking tyres, (4) {161}, have to be wider than those on a mountain bike, (5) {162} that the wheels don't slip on icy surfaces.
paragraphs.tr: 因此，雪地骑行的轮胎必须比山地车的更宽，这样轮子才不会在冰面上打滑。

ana.frame: 主谓：Snow biking tyres, (4) ____, have to be wider than those on a mountain bike, (5) ____ that the wheels don't slip on icy surfaces.
parts: Snow biking tyres, (4) {161} —— 雪地骑行轮胎（缺连接词）
have to be wider than those on a mountain bike —— 必须比山地车更宽
(5) {162} that the wheels don't slip on icy surfaces —— 这样轮子不会在冰面打滑（缺 so）
gram: therefore 因此；so that 以便
ana.tip: 「因此」→ 填 therefore；「以便」→ 填 so（so that）。官方：4 therefore / 5 so。

Reading Part 6 —— 阅读第 6 部分

paragraphs.s: Questions 27–32

ana.frame: 标题：Questions 27–32（第 27–32 题）
gram: 真题部分题号连续编号
ana.tip: 六道题 = 六个空。

paragraphs.s: For each question, write the correct word. Write one word for each gap.
paragraphs.tr: 每题写出正确的词。每个空写一个词。

ana.frame: 祈使句：write the correct word. Write one word for each gap.
parts: write the correct word —— 写出正确的词
Write one word for each gap —— 每空写一个词
ana.tip: 先判断词性（冠词？代词？介词？动词形式？），再想具体的词。

paragraphs.s: As you may know, we had a fantastic fashion show here at the college last week.
paragraphs.tr: 你可能知道，我们上周在学院办了一场很棒的时装秀。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：we had a fantastic fashion show here at the college last week.
parts: As you may know —— 如你所知
had a fantastic fashion show —— 办了一场很棒的时装秀
here at the college last week —— 上周在学院
ana.tip: 开场介绍背景：上周的时装秀。

paragraphs.s: The aim was to display the work that the fashion students {27} recently been involved in all year here at the college, and show parents and friends the results.
paragraphs.tr: 目的是展示时装专业学生这一年一直在学院参与的作品，并把成果给家长和朋友看。

ana.frame: 主系表：The aim was to display the work that the fashion students {27} recently been involved in all year …
parts: was to display the work —— 是展示作品
that the fashion students {27} recently been involved in all year —— 学生们这一年一直参与的
and show parents and friends the results —— 并给家长朋友看成果
clauses: that 定语从句；be involved in 参与
gram: have/had been involved in 一直参与
ana.tip: 空后是 recently been（过去分词）→ 缺助动词 have/had。官方：27 have（或 had）。

paragraphs.s: And it was clear to us that {28} were impressed by it.
paragraphs.tr: 而且我们能看出他们都被它打动了。

ana.frame: 主系表：it was clear to us that {28} were impressed by it.
parts: it was clear to us —— 我们看得很清楚
that {28} were impressed by it —— 他们被打动了（缺主语）
clauses: it 形式主语；that 主语从句
ana.tip: 缺从句主语、指「家长和朋友」→ 填 they。官方：28 they。

note.cn: 深受感动的（were impressed by 被打动）

paragraphs.s: The models that {29} part in the show were actually the students themselves, wearing their own clothes designs.
paragraphs.tr: 参加表演的模特其实都是学生自己，穿着他们自己设计的衣服。

ana.frame: 主系表：The models that {29} part in the show were actually the students themselves …
parts: The models that {29} part in the show —— 参加表演的模特（缺动词）
were actually the students themselves —— 其实是学生自己
wearing their own clothes designs —— 穿着自己设计的衣服
clauses: that 定语从句；take part in 参加
ana.tip: 「参加」→ take part in，过去时 → 填 took。官方：29 took。

paragraphs.s: {30} were some amazingly creative clothes on show, such as a dress made of recycled materials, and a coat that included every colour you could possibly think of!
paragraphs.tr: 展出的还有一些令人惊叹的创意服装，比如一件用回收材料做的连衣裙，和一件包含你能想到的所有颜色的外套！

ana.frame: 存在句：{30} were some amazingly creative clothes on show …
parts: {30} were some amazingly creative clothes on show —— 展出了一些创意服装（缺引导词）
such as a dress made of recycled materials, and a coat that included every colour you could possibly think of —— 比如回收材料做的连衣裙和色彩齐全的外套
clauses: there be 句型；such as 举例
ana.tip: 「有……」存在句 → 填 There。官方：30 There。

paragraphs.s: And the scenery, created {31} the students in the Art Department, was really spectacular too.
paragraphs.tr: 而由艺术系学生创作的布景也非常壮观。

ana.frame: 主系表：the scenery, created {31} the students in the Art Department, was really spectacular too.
parts: the scenery, created {31} the students in the Art Department —— 由艺术系学生创作的布景（缺 by）
ana.tip: 被动语态「由……创作」→ 填 by。官方：31 by。

note.cn: 壮观的，令人惊叹的，惊人的

paragraphs.s: Mrs Jackson, Head of Design, said: 'There's absolutely {32} doubt in my mind that all these students are extremely talented – and I'm sure we'll hear more about them in the future. I wish them every success in their careers.'
paragraphs.tr: 设计主管 Jackson 老师说：「我脑子里绝对没有疑问——这些学生都极有天赋。我相信以后还会听到他们的消息。祝他们事业成功。」

ana.frame: 引语：There's absolutely {32} doubt in my mind that all these students are extremely talented …
parts: There's absolutely {32} doubt in my mind —— 我脑子里绝对……疑问（缺 no）
that all these students are extremely talented —— 这些学生都极有天赋
I wish them every success in their careers —— 祝他们事业成功
gram: there's no doubt that 毫无疑问
ana.tip: 「毫无疑问」→ 填 no（there's no doubt）。官方：32 no。

relative.cn: 关系的（relative pronoun 关系代词）

whose.cn: （关系代词）指代人或者物的（所有格）

buenos.cn: Buenos（Buenos Aires 布宜诺斯艾利斯）

aires.cn: Aires（Buenos Aires 布宜诺斯艾利斯）

bought.cn: 买（buy 的过去式/过去分词）

tastes.cn: 尝起来（taste 的第三人称单数）

used.cn: 使用（use 的过去式/过去分词）

used to.cn: 过去常常（used to do sth）；习惯于（be used to doing sth——注意 to 是介词）

identifying.cn: 识别、找出（identify 的现在分词）

speech.cn: 言语（part of speech 词性）

lives.cn: 生活（life 的复数，读 /laɪvz/）；居住（live 的第三人称单数，读 /lɪvz/）

goes.cn: 去（go 的第三人称单数）

in case.note: in case + 从句（以防…会发生）；in case of + 名词。

let's.cn: = let us 让我们（表建议）

g.cn: 字母 g（选项/编号的标记）

order.note: in order to do sth 为了做某事。

needed.cn: 需要（need 的过去式/过去分词）

suitable.cn: 合适的；the most suitable for 对……最合适的

involves.cn: 包含（involve 的第三人称单数）

ordinary.cn: 普通的，平常的，平淡无奇的

ground.note: on the ground 在地面上；under the ground 在地下。

college.cn: 学院；art college 艺术学院

involved.cn: 包含，涉及（be involved in 参与；involve 的过去分词）

been involved in.cn: 一直参与（be involved in 的完成式）

impressed.cn: 印象深刻的；深受感动的
impressed.note: be impressed by 被打动；be impressed 印象深刻。

included.cn: 包含在内（include 的过去式/过去分词）

created.cn: 创作、创造（create 的过去分词）

spectacular.cn: 壮观的，令人惊叹的，惊人的

head.cn: 头；主管（Head of Design 设计主管）

design.cn: 设计（designing clothes 设计服装）
